answer_1.quote: a conversation module generates responses given the conversation context and item recommendation.
answer_1.outputs: generated conversational responses and item recommendations

answer_2.quote: we adopt Recall@k to evaluate the recommendation subtask.

answer_3.quote: we propose an LLM-based scorer that can automatically give the score through prompting. Specifically, we use the text-davinci-003 model provided in the OpenAI API as the scorer

answer_4.quote: we employ two annotators to judge the relevance degree (irrelevant, partially relevant, or highly relevant) of the explanation to the conversation context and we invite five annotators to play the role of the system and engage in interactions
answer_4.guideline: evaluating relevance of explanations to context and assessing naturalness and usefulness of utterances in pairwise comparisons
